hard_gate_failures: 6: layout flaws. The cover headline block sits high with a large empty gap below it. Slides 4 and 5 end with a one-word last line.
Photos: Genta, Royal Oak and Nautilus photos are in the library but unused, so the story has no visuals.
fixes: slide 1: Use a photo cover. Put the Royal Oak ref. 15202 photo from the library under the headline with its credit, or rebalance the text so the block is centred vertically.
slide 2: Add the Gérald Genta portrait (CC BY-SA 3.0) with its credit, and write the name as 'Gérald' to match the caption.
slide 3: Add the Royal Oak photo, labelled as the modern ref. 15202 with a credit. Keep the text clear of the dial.
slide 4: Shorten to 'Patek Philippe launched the Nautilus in 1976.' so no one-word last line is left. Add the Nautilus 5711 photo, labelled as modern, with a credit.
slide 5: Shorten to 'Genta also designed IWC's Ingenieur, from 1976.' so '1976.' no longer sits alone on a line.
caption: Add 'Photo credits: Wikimedia Commons' with the author and licence for each photo used.
reason: The facts check out against Sotheby's and Wikipedia and the validator passes. The slides are all text with no photos, and slides 4 and 5 leave a one-word last line. The cover also sits high with a big empty gap below.
